title: RoboGaze: Evaluating Robot World Models via Structured Vision-Language Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2606.28385v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Robot world models now generate synthetic manipulation videos, but evaluating them is hard: realistic-looking outputs often violate physical laws, temporal consistency or task logic, while conventional metrics and monolithic Vision-Language Model (VLM) judges return scores that do not say what failed. We present RoboGaze, a training-free multi-agent VLM evaluator that grounds the task and scene, routes each subtask to dimension-specific specialists and verifies their findings with a critic, producing temporally localized diagnostic reports that state what failed, when, why and how severely, under a schema of 6 dimensions and 30 failure types whose annotation reliability and coverage we measure. To benchmark it, we introduce RoboGazeBench, 914 human-annotated clips from five generators, conditioned on simulated and real-world data and running from 4.9 to 148.9 s. translated_title: RoboGaze：通过结构化视觉-语言分析评估机器人世界模型
translated_abstract: 机器人世界模型现已能够生成合成操作视频，但评估这些模型十分困难：看似逼真的输出常常违反物理定律、时间一致性或任务逻辑，而传统指标和单一整体式的视觉-语言模型（VLM）评判器所返回的分数无法说明失败究竟出在哪里。我们提出了RoboGaze，这是一个免训练的多智能体VLM评估器，它对任务和场景进行接地（grounding），将每个子任务路由给针对特定维度的专家智能体，并通过评论者（critic）验证其发现，从而生成时间上可定位的诊断报告，明确说明哪里失败、何时失败、为何失败以及严重程度如何，其采用包含6个维度和30种失败类型的评估体系，我们对这一体系的标注可靠性与覆盖范围进行了测量。为了对该方法进行基准测试，我们引入了RoboGazeBench，其中包含来自五个生成器的914个经人工标注的视频片段，这些片段以仿真和真实世界数据为条件，时长从4.9秒到148.9秒不等。在八个开源与专有VLM骨干模型上，RoboGaze……
tldr: RoboGaze是一个免训练的多智能体视觉-语言模型评估框架，通过结构化多维度分析为机器人世界模型生成的合成操作视频提供时间定位的诊断报告，明确指出失败的内容、时间、原因和严重程度，并配套发布了包含914个人工标注片段的RoboGazeBench基准。
en_tdlr: RoboGaze is a training-free multi-agent VLM evaluator that provides temporally localized diagnostic reports on robot world model-generated manipulation videos—identifying what failed, when, why, and how severely—along with RoboGazeBench, a benchmark of 914 human-annotated clips from five generators.
